name: Backend: unverified account state, the 6-digit code grant, the third mail kind, gated signup/login, verify + resend, tests
outcome: Backend gate built to the notebook's contract — signup creates an unverified account, mails a single-use 6-digit code and opens no session; /auth/verify (password then code) verifies and logs in; login on an unverified account answers verification_required; resend supersedes under a 60 s cooldown; a completed reset also verifies; existing accounts verified by column shape, proven on dev Postgres (+1 columns, 0 pending), 171 tests green, curl-smoked on the running dev API
